item.title: Prosecutor with Soros ties criticized after suspect obtained passport and fled
item.description: The Democratic prosecutor in Fairfax County, Virginia, did not oppose an embassy visit that allowed an accused killer to get a passport before leaving the U.S.

item.title: Axelrod criticizes Ossoff for 'gratuitous' remark about Natalie Harp
item.description: Democratic strategist David Axelrod on Wednesday criticized comments by Sen. Jon Ossoff about President Trump and his longtime aide.

item.title: CNN criticized for intense coverage of Natalie Harp after Ossoff's smear
Karen Bass faces backlash over video showing taxpayer-funded match of donations
item.description: Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass is under scrutiny for a re-election ad that urges donations matched 6-to-1 by taxpayers through a super match program.
